source: endfield.wiki.gg/wiki/Operator/List, fetched 2026-10-07; Chinese names for the off-rate 6-stars supplied by the project owner
six_previous_limited_note: The off-rate pool of a limited banner is the standard five plus the rate-up operators of the previous two limited banners (see banners.json). The two rotating operators are not listed here; the site only asks how many of them the player owns, so this file changes only when the standard pool or the rule changes.
zh_names_note: A plain name dictionary, not pool membership; nothing here has to change when banners rotate. 萊萬汀、潔爾佩塔、艾爾黛拉、駿衛 are from official in-game text; the others were supplied by the project owner.
